# GameSurf — August 2002 Italian preview

- Original source: [Robin Hood](https://www.gamesurf.it/anteprime/gioco/robin-hood-c7494)
- Author / publication: Redazione; GameSurf.
- Language / date: Italian; 2002-08-04.
- Access: Indexed opening and closing assessment inspected; direct retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The preview positions Robin Hood as Spellbound’s follow-up to Desperados. It argues that Desperados initially suffered from being dismissed as a Commandos imitation, whereas the new game would attract greater curiosity. The inspected material recounts the outlaw premise and expresses optimism about the setting and production care.

This is prerelease expectation, not a review of the finished game. It complements GameSurf’s later December review, which again stresses looking beyond an initial impression of similarity to Commandos. The preview’s story retelling is not treated as historical scholarship.
